description: This file contains internal function declarations, macros, and type definitions for OpenSSL's BIO (Basic I/O) socket operations, including socket creation, error handling, and non-blocking configuration.

methods.name: bio_ip_and_port_to_socket_and_addr
methods.description: Creates a socket and fills in address structures for connecting to a specified hostname and port.

methods.name: bio_socket_nbio
methods.description: Sets a socket to non-blocking mode.

methods.name: bio_fd_should_retry
methods.description: Determines if an error is non-fatal and the operation should be retried.
